subject: English Home Language

source.topic: The sky (day and night): Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'q(u)' sound at the beginning of words (quick, quiet, queen)

show.line: Listen. q as in queen. q, q, queen. Queen Quellerina is quiet and quick!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with q, as in queen?
Say the sound with me. q, as in queen!

rounds.story: Queen Quellerina sleeps under a quilt. At night a quiet owl watches the moon. Who sleeps under the quilt?

rounds.prompt: Be quick! Which one starts with q? q, q.
Who is this? She starts with q.
Does it start with q? Put q words in the q group.

hints: Listen for q at the start. q, q, queen.
q sounds like kw. Round your lips. kw, kw.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with q.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Moon starts with m. Queen starts with q.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. q, q, queen. Queen starts with q!

parent_line: Can hear the q sound at the start of words.
